name: read-trimming-filtering
description: Remove adapter sequences and low-quality bases from raw reads. Use fastp for Illumina data: sliding window quality trimming (window size 4, quality threshold 20), adapter auto-detection, poly-G tail removal (NovaSeq two-color chemistry artifact), minimum length filter (36bp for short-insert, 50bp for standard), and per-read quality filter (mean Q below 15 discarded). For long reads, use Porechop for adapter removal or CCS for PacBio subread consensus.
